title: New Catholic confession app Holier gives Catholics an AI companion to finally break free from the same sins and grow holier
description: Laguna Beach, California - October 31, 2026 - Reconciled Software, LLC introduces Holier, a new Catholic confession app for iPhone that gives Catholics an AI companion for the daily fight against sin. Unlike checklist-style confession apps, Holier is built on conversation: Catholics talk through their day, or a temptation, and their confession list is drafted for them, ready to read in the confessional. Holier is available now on the App Store for iPhone.
